author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-02-05 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Would you like a better job?
context_before: Omnipresent, God is alive in you now, so I ask you to test Him.
context_after: Greater income? Greater recognition? What would you do right now if it were true? Now test God by thinking of a friend. Hear him congratulate you on your good fortune. See his face light up with joy and feel his presence. Do that, and you have performed a magical act, for God has acted and all things are possible to God.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Faith In God (1968-02-05).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-02-05 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Do you want a better job?
context_before: In the meantime, test Jesus Christ, God’s creative power in you as your Human Imagination!
context_after: More money? Whatever you want claim it just as simply as I did the rose. Put on the feeling of possession and wear it as though it were true right now. If it is a better job you want, where would you sit if you had it? How would your mate see you? Sit behind that special desk and let your wife (or husband) see you there. Live as though it were true and have faith in Jesus Christ, the creative power and wisdom of God.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Faith In God (1968-02-05).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-02-05 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Imagination is defined as spiritual sensation.
context_before: you will even see the water level in the vase. As you do this, God is streaming into your surface mind least disguised in the form of creative fancy.
context_after: Come, let us now sense spiritual things that are not physically present. Right now I want you to feel a tennis ball, then a baseball, a volleyball, and a golf ball. They all feel different, do they not? If you can discriminate between these different balls, are they not real? If you can touch a tennis ball and spiritually distinguish it from a baseball, it must exist, even though it is unseen by mortal eye. So you see: you can behold a thing that is not seen by the mortal eye as though it were, and if you do your faith in Jesus Christ will cause the unseen to become seen.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Faith In God (1968-02-05).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-02-05 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: So if you desire lovely things, you must imagine lovely thoughts.
context_before: All things were made by the Human Imagination and without Him was not anything made that was made. If during the day you imagine unlovely things, they are going to happen! The world believes that Jesus Christ is another, but the great Hebrew confession of faith tells us: “Hear, O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.” There is only one creator. It is the Human Imagination who kills and makes things alive, wounds and heals. Whether you use or misuse your creative power, the same being will bring it to pass.
context_after: Your friends are your own lack or limitation made visible. Like Job, pray for your friends and your own fears will be lifted.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Faith In God (1968-02-05).
